contents.text: {"hypotheses":[{"experiment_id":"tight_H16","text":"If Sami Okoro (CM) had stood 5 m closer to Arne Dahl, the chance to keep the ball would have been higher (16.0%) and thus more likely to keep possession."},{"experiment_id":"tight_H20","text":"If Leo Marchetti (CM) had stood 1 m closer to Arne Dahl, the chance to keep the ball would have been higher (14.8%) and thus slightly more likely to avoid the turnover."},{"experiment_id":"tight_H11","text":"If Jonah Pike (LM) had stood 5 m closer to Arne Dahl, the chance to keep the ball would have been marginally higher (14.4%) and therefore a marginally safer option."}]}
